```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(brms)
library(marginaleffects)
library(collapse)
library(compositions)
```

```{r}
final_df <- readRDS("D:/Final-Project/DATA/final_df_complete.rds")

model_df <- final_df %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry()

df_urban <- model_df %>% filter(urban_rural %in% "Urban")

cols <- c("pct_0_12","pct_13_21","pct_22_40","pct_41_70","pct_71plus",
          "pct_0car","pct_1car","pct_2plus","pct_none_primary",
          "pct_secondary","pct_tertiary","pct_still_in_edu")

age_cols <- df_urban %>%
  select(SA_PUB2022, pct_0_12, pct_13_21)

matrix_urban     <- df_urban %>% select(all_of(cols)) %>% as.matrix()
variables_ilr    <- ilr(acomp(matrix_urban))
variables_ilr_df <- as.data.frame(variables_ilr)
names(variables_ilr_df) <- paste0("ilr_", cols[-length(cols)])

df_urban_model <- df_urban %>%
  select(-all_of(cols)) %>%
  bind_cols(variables_ilr_df) %>%
  left_join(age_cols, by = "SA_PUB2022")
```

```{r}
df_urban_model <- df_urban_model %>%
  mutate(
    category          = factor(category),
    county            = factor(COUNTY_ENGLISH),
    urban_area        = factor(SA_URBAN_AREA_NAME),
    z_target_pop_norm = as.numeric(scale(target_pop_norm)),

    pop_3_18 = target_pop_norm * (pct_0_12 * 0.75 / 100) +
               target_pop_norm * (pct_13_21 * 0.67 / 100),

    # Log base 10 normalise walking accessibility
    log10_walk_30 = log10(access_walk_30 + 1),

    perc_active_prop = perc_active / 100,
    perc_active_beta = (perc_active_prop * (nrow(.) - 1) + 0.5) / nrow(.)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(access_walk_30),
    !is.na(perc_active_beta),
    !is.na(county),
    !is.na(urban_area),
    !is.na(log10_walk_30),
    pop_3_18 > 0
  ) %>%
  droplevels()

cat("Rows for modelling:", nrow(df_urban_model), "\n")
cat("Walk range (log10):", range(df_urban_model$log10_walk_30), "\n")
```

```{r}
ilr_vars <- names(df_urban_model) %>%
  keep(~ str_starts(.x, "ilr_"))

df_urban_model <- df_urban_model %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(ilr_vars),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)),
      .names = "z_{.col}"
    )
  )

predictors <- c(
  paste0("z_", ilr_vars),
  "log10_walk_30"
)

formula_beta <- as.formula(
  paste("perc_active_beta ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
)

cat("Formula built successfully\n")
cat("log10_walk_30 in data:", "log10_walk_30" %in% names(df_urban_model), "\n")
```

```{r}
priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 2.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "phi")
)
```

```{r model}
model_urban_walk <- brm(
  formula = formula_beta,
  data    = df_urban_model,
  family  = Beta(link = "logit"),
  prior   = priors,
  chains  = 4,
  iter    = 4000,
  warmup  = 1000,
  seed    = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)

saveRDS(model_urban_walk, "D:/Final-Project/DATA/model_urban_walk.rds")
```

```{r}
summary(model_urban_walk)
plot(model_urban_walk)
```

```{r}
model_predictors <- all.vars(formula_beta)[-1]

walk_grid <- seq(
  min(df_urban_model$log10_walk_30, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(df_urban_model$log10_walk_30, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 100
)

newdata_walk <- as_tibble(
  matrix(0, nrow = length(walk_grid), ncol = length(model_predictors))
)
names(newdata_walk) <- model_predictors

newdata_walk <- newdata_walk %>%
  mutate(log10_walk_30 = walk_grid)

pred_walk <- fitted(
  model_urban_walk,
  newdata = newdata_walk,
  scale   = "response",
  probs   = c(0.125, 0.875)
)

plot_walk <- bind_cols(newdata_walk, as_tibble(pred_walk)) %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate_pct = Estimate * 100,
    Q2.5_pct     = Q12.5 * 100,
    Q97.5_pct    = Q87.5 * 100
  )

ggplot(plot_walk, aes(x = log10_walk_30, y = Estimate_pct)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Q2.5_pct, ymax = Q97.5_pct), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4),
    labels = c("0", "10", "100", "1,000", "10,000")
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Effect of walking accessibility on active travel",
    subtitle = "Other predictors fixed at their average standardised value",
    x        = "School places reachable by walking (30 min)",
    y        = "Active travel (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

saveRDS(df_urban_model,   "D:/Final-Project/DATA/df_urban_model_walk.rds")
